card.name: As prescribed or directed by provider
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about following a clinician's instructions, such as 'as prescribed', 'as directed by your physician', or 'tells you to take it'. It fires on the word just before or at the prescriber or the prescribed amount.

modes.description: The word provider or a linking word in 'as your healthcare provider tells you'.
modes.example: exactly as your healthcare<< provider>> tells you to take it.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward prescribe-related words such as prescribed, prescription and prescribing.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text says to follow what the prescriber ordered.
